messages:
megan: heads-up — customer reported double billing after a streaming session that invoked a tool during a reconnect. trace=lc-4a8f

paul: double charge = provisional + confirmed or duplicate confirmed?

megan: provisional written at router-accept (estimate 126 tokens). mid-stream reconnect triggered a route-swap to a fallback cluster, router sanitized headers and dropped client idempotency header. runtime retried the toolcall and emitted a confirmed charge of 101 tokens. ledger shows both entries. logs:```
[lc-4a8f] router: accept provisional=126 model=redwood-xxl
[lc-4a8f] router: route-swap -> fallback-zone (sanitize-headers=true)
[lc-4a8f] runtime: toolcall retried, client-idempotency=null
[lc-4a8f] billing: ledger write provisional +126
[lc-4a8f] billing: ledger write confirmed +101
```

jordi: two bugs: header preservation on swap + billing not reconciling provisional vs final. billing currently dedupes only on runtime_request_id (post-toolcall), which doesn't survive header loss.

tara: proposal: router should mint a stable X-Session-Commit-ID at ingress and attach it to all downstream requests. billing should record provisional entries keyed by session_commit_id (pending) and upsert/replace when a confirmed entry with the same session_commit_id arrives. runtime should accept the header if present; if absent it may synthesize but billing will tag it runtime-scoped.

megan: +1. semantics: provisional = pending estimate (not invoiced). on confirmed arrival, replace pending with final. if confirmed never arrives within TTL (e.g., 24h), expire pending and create an adjustment ticket. avoid heuristics like min/max token merges.

paul: telemetry: emit events router.session.start(session_commit_id, estimate, model_hint), billing.pending.created(session_commit_id, estimate), billing.pending.finalized(session_commit_id, final_tokens), billing.pending.expired(session_commit_id). use session_commit_id as observability join key.

jordi: consoles/UX: show a separate "pending tokens" column in billing UI with tooltip "pending estimate 24h TTL3 and link to disputes. admin filter for large pending deltas and a dashboard tile: "pending -> finalized delta" (pct + absolute tokens). alert when delta > 5% across 10m for orgs > threshold.

tara: internal API debate: should router or runtime generate session_commit_id? router wins for survivability across reroutes. downside: router slightly coupled to billing contract. compromise: router emits optional X-Session-Commit-ID; runtime honors if present and includes it in runtime traces. if missing, runtime synthesizes and billing treats it as runtime-scoped.

billing-bot: note: ledger changes required: add pending bucket (pending_balance) separate from invoiced_balance; migration plan for existing provisional rows; new events as mentioned. quota behavior: provisional must reserve quota on accept; finalization consumes reservation and records actual usage; if pending expires, release reservation. coordinate with quota team.

megan: short-term mitigations: 1) revert the header-sanitization rule in the canary immediately, 2) add a runtime guard to reject toolcall replay when neither client idempotency header nor session_commit_id is present (fail-fast), 3) add a tracer log from router emitting session_commit_id for recent sessions for triage.

paul: owners: router#821 add-session-commit-header (@tara), billing#914 pending-ledger-migration (@megan), console#556 pending-ui (@jordi), telemetry#333 session-commit-events (@paul).

jordi: QA scenarios to add: route-swap with header preserved, route-swap with header lost, client retry with idempotency preserved, model-fallback with token delta (higher and lower), truncated stream EOF vs reconnect, late confirmation after TTL. add integration tests asserting ledger replaces pending with finalized and quota reservations behave correctly.

megan: I'll draft the billing design doc and open the router revert PR. ping when PRs are in flight. :thumbsup:
